sharedPrompt: Use case: style-transfer. Produce ONE production sprite atlas for a layered 2D chibi paper-doll game, on genuine transparent RGBA background. Image 1 is the approved DeepSeek STYLE reference: match its polished rounded 2-head-tall proportions, large shiny eyes, clean dark outlines and soft cel shading. Image 2 is CHARACTER IDENTITY only: preserve that character's hair, eyes, costume and accessories, simplify ornament for a 108-pixel-tall game sprite. Do NOT copy DeepSeek's whale/maid identity onto the new character. Strict layout: square atlas, exactly FOUR equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 16 isolated cutouts, each centered in its own cell with generous transparent gutters, no crossing cell boundaries. No labels, text, grid lines, ground shadows, backgrounds or watermark. Row 1: four identical-size front-view HEADS (head, short framing hair, ears, ornaments ONLY, no shoulders or long rear hair), in neutral smile, happy open-mouth, surprised O-mouth, sleepy closed-eyes expressions. Keep head outline and accessories registered identically. Row 2: (1) complete clothed torso and short flared skirt, with neck but NO head/arms/legs, concealed shoulders fully painted; (2) screen-left relaxed full arm with matching sleeve and hand, shoulder root at upper-right; (3) screen-right relaxed full arm with matching sleeve and hand, shoulder root at upper-left; (4) screen-left short leg with stocking and shoe, upper thigh overlap included. Row 3: (1) screen-right short leg with stocking and shoe; (2) screen-left bent full arm holding a pencil pointing downward toward a desk; (3) screen-right bent full arm resting hand on desk; (4) screen-left bent full arm holding a small rice bowl near chest. Row 4: (1) screen-right bent full arm raising a spoon toward mouth; (2) FULL BODY seated resting chibi, knees bent, hands resting on lap, eyes closed, same outfit, actual seated pose, no cushion; (3) separate long rear hair mass with full hidden center painted, no face/body; (4) separate character-specific tail or rear ornament specified below. All arms include fully painted sleeve roots with overlap. Keep front-facing orientation and lighting consistent. Cutouts are anatomical illustrated game parts, not schematic shapes. Render at the highest useful square resolution.
